name: @561-group/proof-pathing
description: Proof-pathing: the Meme-structure → typed-path fold, read through Curry-Howard-Lambek. A path is a PROOF — the composite of predicate-category generator morphisms (specialization, converse, subject-/object-projection) from a foundational root to a target, driven to the least fixed point of the path-composition monad (the MPU's saturate/μ). The accumulated generator sequence IS the proof term; rendered to a typed POSIX path (root/<morphism>/library/<term>/…), the term is its own collision-free index (Yoneda), and walking the path re-checks the proof.
